issues: The proposed invariant and scaling probes treat the correct ZeroSumNormal logp as a constant multiple of the full independent-normal logp; the documented orthonormal/reduced-coordinate model requires the quadratic term to remain unscaled, with only normalization/Jacobian adjusted.
two_dim_logp_scaling omits ndim_supp=2, so it does not construct the two-axis constrained matrix distribution and its expected ratio is invalid.
orthonormal_basis_equivalence only checks finiteness and does not compare to reduced coordinates, so it cannot detect the bug.
sigma_scaling_invariance uses an incorrect expected difference and can fail on a correct implementation.
An acceptance check is self-contradictory about adding a constant to a zero-sum vector, and the brief does not clearly state which probes must fail on the unpatched code.
suggested_fixes: State the invariant as equality to the reduced-coordinate Normal/MvNormal logp plus the appropriate Jacobian, not as a scaled full independent-normal logp.
Use ndim_supp=2 for two-axis probes and compare against a reduced-coordinate representation or an MvNormal with the documented centered covariance.
Rewrite the orthonormal probe to construct an orthonormal zero-sum basis and compare logp values explicitly.
Replace the sigma scaling probe with a correct scale relation or covariance-based comparison.
Explicitly identify which probes should fail before the fix and which are only sanity checks.
